lines.1: 「Thus, the translation here is, 'So that's what it was after all!' Mind where you place the stress.」
lines.2: 「For the next example sentence... As it is now 9:31, Samesuga, if you please.」
lines.3: What connection did Fukahire have to 9:31?
lines.4: Miss Inori's method of calling on people made no sense, so nobody could let their guard down.
lines.6: 「That will be all for today. The final exam will contain more written questions, so do study hard, everyone.」
lines.7: Groans of protest rose all around the room.
lines.8: 「Normally, a score of thirty or below earns a failing grade and a retest. In English alone, however, anyone scoring fifty or below will receive additional worksheets.」
lines.10: 「Anyone who fails to complete them will, regrettably, be sentenced to 'island exile.'」
lines.11: She had just pronounced our execution with a smile.
lines.13: 「Please understand. This is the whip of love, wielded only because I care for you all... Besides, having one of my students repeat the year would ruin my reputation as your homeroom teacher.」
lines.16: Fukahire--now called that even by our teacher--stood up.
lines.17: 「I am entirely in favor of the whip of love.」
lines.18: 「In fact, if you were the one wielding it, Miss Inori, I would have no objection to being whipped for real.」
lines.19: What the hell was this idiot saying?
lines.20: 「However! You know the saying: candy and the whip. We sensitive modern youths will break if all we get is the whip. We're so protected from everything that we've gone soft.」
lines.21: 「In short, I believe students who work hard need some sweet 'candy' too!」
lines.22: 「Indeed. That is why I regularly give you candy.」
lines.23: 「Not actual candy... I mean something that could satisfy the yearnings of youth. Something hot, sweet, and melting...」
lines.24: 「(Whisper, whisper... Shinichi is at it again...)」
lines.25: 「(Whisper, whisper... That is... kind of gross.)」
lines.26: His stock with the girls was dropping yet again.
lines.27: 「Don't be such a spoiled little brat. She's going out of her way to save you when she could just abandon you, so show some gratitude.」
lines.30: 「You want a reward? Expecting to get something back every time you do something is exactly why you're already a lost cause.」
lines.31: 「And if you've got the nerve to demand a prize, earn a perfect score like the Princess first. Your glasses are the only thing that should be this foggy.」
lines.34: A human being apologizing to a parrot had to be a first...
lines.35: 「Grrr... Mr. Tsuchinaga sure says whatever he wants.」
lines.36: 「But he is a bird. Nothing we can do about it.」
